scientific_integrity: Entire infinite parameter range proved using structural excess bounds, forced partner profiles, and an exhaustive finite profile certificate. Exact integer tests validate the formulas; they are not substitutes for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts unlabeled blocks with labeled vertices only for complete bipartite K_{r,s}, 3<=r<=s. Does not classify nonmaximal partitions or arbitrary graphs; independent publication priority has not been certified.
title: Every optimal double-coalition partition of a complete bipartite graph
